patch_description:
Replace the unstructured random sample with a deterministic multi-start maximin search in the unit square. Four fixed corner points make the convex hull exactly the unit-area square, so raw triangle areas equal the normalized score. The remaining nine points are optimized using annealed local moves evaluated against all 286 triangles, with a secondary “smallest-triangles” term early in the search to avoid poor local maxima. A final deterministic directional refinement directly improves the true minimum area.

This is reproducible because the generator has a fixed seed, avoids external optimization dependencies, and always returns exactly thirteen finite, unique points within the convex unit square.
